prompts.atlas: Production 2D pixel-art game asset sheet: SIX separate small floating island map icons, neatly arranged in exactly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, transparent background. Each icon fully contained inside its own cell with generous empty transparent gutters on ALL sides. Same three-quarter overhead perspective and same charming hand-placed chunky pixel clusters, crisp dark navy outlines, 16-bit adventure art, limited saturated palette, no gradients, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no characters. Top-left: lush emerald forest island with giant tree and tiny cozy treehouse. Top-center: tropical beach island with golden sand crescent, turquoise lagoon, palm trees, tiny jetty. Top-right: enchanted purple forest island with violet trees, glowing cyan mushrooms and crystal clusters. Bottom-left: UNDERWORLD island: jagged black rock grotto cutaway, orange lava river, glowing sacred blue-and-orange altar, suspended chains, entirely dark volcanic geology with no vegetation. Bottom-center: executive research laboratory island with white and teal industrial building, glass tubes, green chemical tanks, loading dock, modest grey towers. Bottom-right: sinister corporation headquarters island with tall dark blue skyscraper, golden emblem abstract paw (no letters), red warning lights, steel landing pad. Each island has a thick exposed rocky underside, natural irregular silhouette, no objects clipped. All six have comparable visual weight and framing. Designed to be readable at 95 pixels wide each. Wide 1536x1024 sheet, 512x512 cells. Keep edges of each cell empty. Transparent real alpha, no checkerboard drawn.
prompts.background: Landscape 16:9 PIXEL ART BACKGROUND for a charming 16-bit adventure game's island travel map. No islands, no buildings, no boats, no characters, NO TEXT, NO UI. An expansive serene deep teal blue ocean viewed obliquely from the sky, sparse tiny horizontal pale aqua wave pixel dashes, a few low contrast curling sea currents, scattered soft cream pixel cloud wisps only at the extreme corners. In the LOWEST QUARTER, the ocean opens into an underground dark navy cavern cutaway: subtle layered rocky strata along the bottom edge, distant dark indigo cavern walls with a few very faint warm red embers. Clear transition from open turquoise ocean above to underground cavern below, no central objects. Entire middle three quarters left EMPTY and low contrast for six bright floating island icons to be composited over it. Crisp chunky pixel clusters, no fine busy texture, clean limited palette, atmospheric and elegant, cozy adventure. Navy corners frame bright teal middle. Background only, flat panoramic plate, no border, no lettering. Wide 1536x864 composition.
